parameters.apprise_url_plus: clicksend://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.user_secret }} }:${ customer_secrets.{{ params.apikey_secret }} }@${ customer_secrets.{{ params.targets_secret }} }
parameters.description:
Send an SMS to your own ClickSend account by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-clicksend-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `clicksend://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Four channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters; the `gateway` channel transforms the envelope directly into a ClickSend SMS API JSON body and posts it to api.clicksend.com with no Apprise (free); and the `gateway-plus` channel does the same for extra per-enrollment destinations at $0.001 per message.
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"messages":[{"source":"php","to":"${ customer_secrets.CLICKSEND_SMS_TO }","body":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "") .. ((_body.title and _body.title ~= "" and _body.body and _body.body ~= "") and ": " or "") .. (_body.body or "")) *}}]}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment ClickSend destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your ClickSend number (no Apprise)
